_comment: Notice-board request templates (Milestone B, 2026-10-08). The contract is docs/SOCIAL_AND_QUESTS.md section 5; loaded by scripts/quest_db.gd. kind deliver takes a pool (crop, forage, material, salvage, cooked, artisan) or items (a list of candidate ids; one is picked per posting); kind hunt takes an enemy (shambler, runner, bloater, rad_hound or any, never raiders). count is [min, max]. Optional gates: min_day (absolute day), min_runs (expeditions so far), season. Tokens in text: {count}, {item} (the pluralised item name, or for a hunt the enemy's name), {due} (the weekday it's due) and {npc} (the requester's name); thanks lines use none. Rewards are computed by the engine, never authored. Routing: salvage goes to Kael, Wren and Brask and hunts to Brask and Kael, all gated on min_runs; food (crop, cooked, artisan) to Marta, Harlan and Doc; material to Harlan and Brask; Silas asks for feed, goat treats and bandages. Hunts for bloaters (Downtown and deeper) and rad-hounds (Industrial Quarter and deeper) wait for more runs, since templates can't gate on depth. Titles are at most 24 characters, text and thanks at most 180; tools/validate_social_data.py checks this file.

templates.title: Reserve Bins
templates.text: The town reserve bins need topping up. {npc} asks for {count} {item}, delivered by {due} and signed for in ink.
templates.thanks: Into the bins they go! I've logged it in the good ledger, twice. Here's your payment, with the town's thanks.

templates.title: Plaza Repairs
templates.text: The plaza needs patching before the next town meeting. Bring Mayor Harlan {count} {item} by {due}.
templates.thanks: Splendid! The plaza thanks you, I thank you, and the minutes will thank you at some length.

templates.title: Town Supper
templates.text: Harlan is hosting a supper for the whole settlement and has rather overpromised. He needs {count} {item} by {due}.
templates.thanks: Supper is saved! I'll be giving a speech, of course. A short one. Medium. You'll see.

templates.title: Shelf Filler
templates.text: Marta's shelf is looking thin. Bring her {count} {item} by {due}. She pays well, and would like that remembered.
templates.thanks: Oh, these'll be gone by lunch. Here, as promised, and thank you. Don't tell the chicken I said thank you.

templates.title: Caravan Order
templates.text: A caravan wants finished goods, and Marta wants the margin. Bring her {count} {item} by {due}.
templates.thanks: Perfect. The caravan pays me, I pay you, and we all pretend there's no markup. Lovely doing business.

templates.title: Wild Goods
templates.text: Marta can sell wild goods at a markup. She needs {count} {item} by {due}, and won't say how big a markup.
templates.thanks: Picked fresh, sold fresher. Here's your cut. It's fair. I checked twice.

templates.title: Truck Parts
templates.text: Kael's truck needs patching before the next run. Bring him {count} {item} from the ruins by {due}.
templates.thanks: That'll hold it together. Probably. Thanks, kid. Here, for your trouble.

templates.title: Clear the Road
templates.text: Runners keep chasing Kael's truck through the ruins. Put down {count} {item} and report back by {due}.
templates.thanks: Road's quieter already. I can hear myself worry again. Here.

templates.title: Hound Trouble
templates.text: A rad-hound pack is working the deep districts. Kael wants {count} {item} put down before they learn his route. By {due}.
templates.thanks: Pack's thinner, truck's safer, and you're scarier. All good news. Take this.

templates.title: Winter Feed
templates.text: Silas is laying in feed for Grey Winter. Bring him {count} {item} by {due}. The goats will pretend not to care.
templates.thanks: That'll see the herd through the cold. Thank you, seedling. Dorothy says thank you too. Well. She chewed it.

templates.title: Goat Treats
templates.text: Silas wants {count} {item} for the herd. Treats, he says. Bribes, says anyone who's met Dorothy. By {due}, please.
templates.thanks: Oh, they'll love these. Well, they'll eat these. With goats it's the same thing. Here, seedling.

templates.title: Dorothy Again
templates.text: Dorothy picked a fight with a fence post, and lost. Silas needs {count} {item} for her leg by {due}.
templates.thanks: She'll be right as rain, and twice as cross about it. Thank you, seedling. You've a good heart.

templates.title: Mend the Wall
templates.text: Brask found a soft spot in the wall. He wants {count} {item} at the west gate by {due}. No speeches.
templates.thanks: Good. Wall's whole. Take this.

templates.title: Gate Hardware
templates.text: Brask is rebuilding the gate hinges, bolt by bolt. He needs {count} {item} from the ruins by {due}.
templates.thanks: Good haul. Hinges'll outlast us both. Here.

templates.title: Thin the Herd
templates.text: Brask wants {count} {item} put down in the ruins. Report back by {due}.
templates.thanks: Good. Fewer of them, more of us.

templates.title: Bloater Duty
templates.text: Brask wants {count} {item} burst before they drift onto Kael's road. From a distance. By {due}.
templates.thanks: From a distance? Good. Smart. Here.

templates.title: No Questions
templates.text: Wren wants {count} {item} by {due}. She won't say what for, and she's very clear that you shouldn't ask.
templates.thanks: Perfect. Don't ask. Seriously, don't. This is for you, and also for not asking.

templates.title: Glow in the Dark
templates.text: Wren needs {count} {item} by {due}. Something about a map that only shows up in the right light.
templates.thanks: These are perfect. The map's real, by the way. Probably. Here's your share.

templates.title: Shiny Things
templates.text: Wren wants {count} {item}, brought quietly to the fire pit by {due}. She says it's for a lantern.
templates.thanks: It's not for a lantern. Thanks, Mudfoot. Here's something for your trouble, and your discretion.

templates.title: Doctor's Orders
templates.text: Doc Ama is prescribing vegetables to the whole town. She needs {count} {item} by {due}. No substitutions.
templates.thanks: Excellent. Somebody in this town is eating a vegetable tonight, and they'll never know it was you.

templates.title: Herbal Remedies
templates.text: {npc} needs {count} {item} for her remedies, picked clean and brought to her by {due}.
templates.thanks: Lovely and fresh. I'll make something useful out of these. Possibly even something pleasant.

templates.title: Patient Supper
templates.text: Doc has a patient who won't eat. She needs {count} {item} by {due}, something warm with a smell that argues.
templates.thanks: That did it. Two bites in, they were asking for thirds. A doctor's thanks, and a doctor's pay.
